g.text: Peripheral neuropathy includes preferred terms from the system organ class of peripheral neuropathy, including: peripheral neuropathy, peripheral sensory neuropathy, paraesthesia,
hypoaesthesia, polyneuropathy, peripheral motor neuropathy, dysaesthesia, neuralgia, peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy, hypotonia, hyporeﬂexia, neuromyopathy, ear paresthesia, peroneal
Al Swefieh, 19, Mahmoud Al-Mousa Obaidat Str.
